title: Pitfalls
text: I’m going to think this through. First, let’s sort out what needs to be done.

I want to see Filo-tan. I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her. I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her. I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her. I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her, I want to see her.
“Um, are you okay?”
“Huh? What is it?”
Before I knew it, my Father was peering at me and speaking up.
“You looked so spaced out, I got worried… Look, it seems they’re here to show us the way.”
“That’s right. Well then, shall we go?”
“Yeah.”

I walk behind my Father toward the Throne Room. Let’s get back to my train of thought. Whenever one of the Four Holy Heroes dies, I get stuck in a loop back to the very first day. And that means I still haven’t been able to meet Filo-tan.

At first, I saw my Father off, hoping that by saving him from the false rape accusation, he’d be able to live happily. After all, my goal is to become Filo-tan’s master. But I ended up looping back before I could become Filo-tan’s master. The cause of this loop is undoubtedly nothing other than my Father dying somewhere along the way.
So, I have to make sure my father doesn’t die. Even if I manage to become Filo-tan’s master, it’ll be meaningless if I just end up in a loop again. What should I do to prevent that?
“Hey…”
My father gave me a light nudge with his elbow. I’d been lost in thought and hadn’t been listening to a word he said.
“Huh? What is it?”
“No, just introducing myself.”
“Ah, my name is Motoyasu Kitamura, and I’m—”
Not much has changed here. I’ll introduce myself just like before. …That said, if I, Trash, deliberately leave out my Father’s name, he’ll fly into a rage.
“Don’t you dare forget my Father’s nameaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”
“Huh!?”
My Father looks completely dumbfounded.
“Father!?”
Let’s save the explanation for later.
“Come on, Father. Let’s get out of here quickly!”
If we stay here, we’ll fall into another trap. I, Motoyasu, simply cannot bear to see you suffer.
“Father… are you talking about me? Motoyasu?”
“That’s right.”
“Why? And could you please explain why you’re angry?”
“Very well. I’ve come from the future.”
“Huh!?”
“I was wondering what you were going to say…”

Ren and Itsuki muttered as if exasperated. It seems these two almost certainly won’t believe me. Being VRMMOs and people with supernatural abilities, their minds just can’t accept such outlandish claims.
“From the future? I can’t believe it.”

“Then let me explain. This country, Melromarc, is plotting to persecute my Father, the Shield Hero! If things continue like this, my Father will be lured into a trap… and go through a very painful ordeal.”
I pleaded earnestly. Based on how things have been going so far, this is a fact that will definitely happen if we just stand by and watch. He shouldn’t have to go through an experience like that.
“And I can say this because I’m looping through the same timeline!”
I transformed my spear into the Minute Hand of the Dragon Hourglass to demonstrate.
“Um… are they really trying to set a trap for me?”
My Father tilted his head and asked Trash. Trash, meanwhile, feigned composure and stood with his chest puffed out.

“I was wondering what you were going to say… what a strange twist of fate. Our nation intends to treat all Heroes with equal respect and courtesy. Spear Hero, I’d ask you to calm down a bit. Your memory must be clouded by the aftereffects of the summoning.”
“…I see.”
“That might be true.”
“Um, Motoyasu, it looks like that’s not the case.”
Of all people, even my father didn’t believe my words.
“That’s definitely a lie.”
“Hmm… Perhaps we should wait until the Spear Hero has calmed down before continuing this discussion.”

To Trash’s suggestion, the heroes—including Father—actually nodded in agreement. However, it didn’t seem like all the heroes completely believed Trash. Well, thinking about it logically, with four heroes present, he wouldn’t just go around revealing his true nature. I’ll have to wait for the right opportunity and do my best to earn their trust.
“I don’t get any of this…”
“I was hoping you’d explain why we’re even here.”
“I’ll explain that.”
“Yeah, yeah.”
“First off, Ren-kun comes from Japan, where VRMMOs exist. As for Itsuki-kun… I remember now! He was summoned from Japan, where people have psychic powers.”
“What about my world?”
Huh? Did Father’s world have any distinctive features?
“I don’t know. Since he was so surprised by Ren-kun and Itsuki-kun’s Japan, it’s probably just ordinary Japan, isn’t it?”
At least as far as I know, it seems to be ordinary Japan. Just as I was thinking that, Ren said with an exasperated look.
“Huh… so, Ren, do VRMMOs really exist?”
“Why are you stating the obvious? That’s such common sense it doesn’t even need explaining.”
“Huh!?”
“Huh!?”
At Ren’s words, Father and Itsuki’s voices cracked. I was surprised by it at first, too.
“No way, there’s no such thing!”
“Yeah, there isn’t.”
“Th-then what about psychic powers, Itsuki?”
“You mean supernatural abilities? There are people who possess those.”
“No way!”
“There’s no such thing!”
“Y-You, Heroes, please calm down!”
Trash and his aides stepped between us.
“Hmm… I’m starting to feel like there might be a bit of truth to Motoyasu’s story after all.”
“The guy who’s trying to set me up?”
“Yes. My Father will be stripped of everything on a false charge of raping one of his own men.”
“…Is that true?”
I nodded slightly. Father’s face turned pale as he stared at Trash.
“Boo!”
Just then… a red pig in a dress emerged from behind the throne room. This was a turn of events we hadn’t seen before.
“Bubububu, bub? Bubububu.”
“H-huh…”
“N-nice to meet you.”
“Oo-oo-oo-oo-oo-oo-oo!”
My father and the others bowed their heads in deference. The red pig… it’s definitely him.
“He’s the mastermind behind that false accusation!”
When I pointed at him, the red pig rolled his eyes, then struck a pose with his hand on his chest and said something.
“I can’t make out a word of what he’s saying.”
“Huh? Motoyasu, can’t you hear him?”
“It just sounds like a pig grunting to me, Father. I’d like you to explain it to me.”

“Pig… Could you please stop calling me that? Um, well. ‘It seems the Spear Hero possesses the power to foresee the future. To prevent such an outcome, our nation will do everything in its power to support the Shield Hero,’ is what he said.”
You Crimson Swine Bitch! Saying things you don’t even mean!
“Bububububu…”
“Huh? Oh, uh… okay.”
“I suppose that’s for the best.”
“What do you think they’re saying?”

I put all my strength into my spear and take a fighting stance, ready to battle at any moment. But… we’re at a bit of a disadvantage here. My Father and the others are Level 1. If we get into a major skirmish here, we’ll likely lose our lives in no time.
“It seems they’re going to send me to the kingdom of Siltvelt, where they welcome the Shield Hero so I won’t be persecuted.”
Hmm… that does seem to make sense. What kind of change of heart is this?
“What a noble princess. In contrast, Motoyasu, please calm down. It seems you’ve mastered precognition, but your accuracy is poor.”
“It looks like the World of Itsuki has psychic abilities. I see… so Motoyasu is one of those psychics.”
“It might be ‘future calculation.’ There are many emotionally unstable people here, and while it sometimes hits the mark, it’s more often wrong.”
My father-in-law and the others nodded along without being asked.
“I’m not lying!”
“Calm down, Motoyasu. We’re not doubting you, so sheathe your spear.”
Hmm… Since my father-in-law said that, I have no choice but to back down. I sheathed my spear while remaining on guard.
“Anyway, first we should probably deepen our understanding of our world.”
“Even so… it looks like I’ll have to leave this country right away.”
My father muttered, sounding utterly defeated.
“Oink, oink, oink, oink, oink, oink, oink.”
Then the red pig started oinking away, as if giving an explanation. It seemed to be about Status Magic.
“Um, how do we view it?”
“What’s wrong with you guys? Didn’t you notice this right away when you came to this world?”
Ren, looking like he knew exactly what he was talking about, started to explain.
“Don’t you see an icon somewhere in the corner of your vision? Try focusing your attention on it.”
I cut in midway and said that. Ignoring a dumbfounded Ren, my Father and the others seemed to be checking their stats.
“Level 1, huh… This is worrisome.”
“I mean, what even is this?”
“Bububububububububuuuuuubuhi”
I mean, Crimson Swine! I can’t understand a word you’re saying! Speak human!
“Is that so?”
“So, what are we supposed to do? This number definitely is a cause for concern.”
“Bububububububububu”
“Enhancement? Isn’t the weapon we’re holding already strong to begin with?”
“Yes. According to legend, the summoned hero is supposed to nurture and strengthen the Legendary Weapons they possess.”
It seems… they’re discussing how to get stronger. However, there’s a secret to this strengthening. It won’t work unless everyone trusts me, so I’ll only tell my Father about it.
“Even if you call them Legendary Weapons, I’m using a shield. Wouldn’t it be better to use a sword?”

All right! Now’s the time for me to take the lead in this conversation and earn his trust! It’d be a real hassle if he thought my explanations were inaccurate because of my Itsuki ability or whatever.
“Unfortunately, the Legendary Weapons don’t allow you to equip any other weapons.”
“Huh!? Is that so? But that’s what Motoyasu said…”
“Right, so… you should rely on your party members, Father.”
“Does that mean the four of us are forming a party?”
“That won’t work either.”
“Huh?”
“The Hero’s Weapon will repel them, so they won’t gain any EXP. You can share materials for weapon growth, though.”
“That’s pretty inconvenient… But coming from Motoyasu…”
“I know, right? He’s been nothing but negative this whole time… Is this guy really okay?”

And it looks like Crimson Swine is directing those words at my Father. For some reason, I get the feeling I haven’t earned their trust. My instincts—honed while racing through the great outdoors with Filolial-sama—are telling me this situation is very dangerous.
“It seems to be true. So, does that mean I should just gather companions over in Siltvelt…?”
“It seems your standing in this country is precarious. That sounds like a reasonable plan.”
“Oink-oink-oink-oink!”
“Uh, yeah. Got it. Um, Motoyasu.”
“What is it?”
My father, looking a bit embarrassed as the Crimson Swine was pestering him, called out to me.
“He says the carriage to Siltvelt won’t be ready until tomorrow, so he wants us to get some rest.”
“It seems we’re supposed to gather our own companions.”
“Hmm…”
Well, it does make sense, I suppose. If it can prevent trouble before it happens… I wouldn’t mind sparing their lives.
“Understood.”
“Then, I’ll escort each of you, Heroes, to your private rooms.”
Huh? We were supposed to be sharing a room until now…? I wonder what caused this change.
“I’m not leaving the side of my Father.”
“No, please, could you not follow me? It’s kind of scary—I feel like you’re targeting me…”

My father is making a blatantly displeased face. Did I do something wrong? Or perhaps I was being too familiar. Come to think of it, this is the first time I’ve met this father. Maybe it’s a matter that goes beyond whether he trusts me or not.
“I’ll hear the details later, okay?”
……If my father is ordering me to do this, I suppose I have no choice. If anything happens, I’ll just have to rush over right away.
“Understood. But I’ll compromise by staying in the room next to your room.”
“O-okay. I’ll have a room prepared.”
And so, I ended up staying in the room next to my Father’s room. As the sun set… I lay in wait, keeping my ears open so I could handle whatever happened in the room, when a soldier arrived.
“Spear Hero, it’s time for dinner.”

Oh! Finally, I’ll be able to talk to my Father. If I don’t teach my Father various ways to become stronger, overcoming the challenges ahead will be nothing but a pipe dream. First and foremost, I must make saving his life my top priority. With that in mind, I opened the door and looked at the soldier.
“The other Heroes have already gone to dinner. Please hurry, Spear Hero.”
“Understood.”
I hurried off toward the dining hall.
“Ah! Wait a moment!”
“What is it?”
“That’s not where they’re eating. Please show me the way.”
Huh? Has the dining location changed? I stop in my tracks and turn around.
“Then where is it?”
I’ve been inside the castle a few times before, so I remember it fairly well. If you just tell me, I don’t even need to be guided.
“This way.”
That’s all the soldier would say. Hmm… this is a hassle. Then, guided by the soldier, I passed through the castle’s great hall… and was led all the way to the entrance of the castle.
“Please wait here.”
“Where are my Father and the others?”
“Hmph…”

Huh? Just as I sensed a sudden, ominous presence and was about to draw my spear, I felt my body lift into the air. By the time I realized what was happening, a hole had opened in the floor, and I was falling through it.
